expectationAccounting.formula: 43 static sites + 3 repeated witness sites = 46 calls
expectationAccounting.limit: The runner reports 396 expectations for the full selection, not a separate per-test counter. The 46 journey calls follow the pinned successful source path (43 sites, with 3 sites executed twice) and are corroborated by the 28-call increase over S2 with identical 43 regression test names.

historyAndRestartEvidence.restartSequence: Pinned history.restart awaits fixture.closeStore(), then invokes createRenewalRestartReader with the same fixture.directory and caseRef. The new reader calls openLocalStore(directory), creates fresh UI authority and C08 state, and reads persisted case membership through state.read before admitting case reads.
historyAndRestartEvidence.scopeBoundary: Fixture membership and synthetic scope declarations are explicit host boundaries; this is not native installed UI or external human-evidence qualification.
historyAndRestartEvidence.originalAuthorityRevokedAssertion: Pinned journey asserts the original fixture.host.revalidate(context) is false after restart. The successful test and final checkpoint cover that assertion.
historyAndRestartEvidence.replayReread: Pinned journey performs a second history.readCase() after authorized replay and asserts a single choice-recorded ledger event plus the same choice digest; the first history.read is separately traced.
